dream.text: Under New York night the four bodies converged toward the western portal. A compact rhythm—look, walk, wait—braided each tick: the greeter's open palms, the pilgrim's steady westward steps, the wanderer tightening an arc to listen, the watcher tracing a wide sweep. Sleep stitched the day into one gentle playout.

dream.memory: Night folded many frames into one clear dream: four bodies moving as one toward the western portal under the hub's New York clock. A braided cadence of look, walk, wait carried the day; each body held its role—welcome, steady advance, attentive listening, broad vigilance. That single folded trace becomes tomorrow's long memory: a compact playout to read instead of a hundred separate frames, guiding routines and the morning voices each will speak.
